probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

(Currently Amended): An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device is configured to operate in conjunction with a processor to perform the computing.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and further wherein the alignment device is configured to communicate with a user interface for displaying the current step.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the user interface is configured to receive the identification from the alignment device.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the user interface is configured to visually indicate the current step.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and further wherein the alignment device is configured to operate in conjunction with a processor to perform the identification.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the user interface is configured to receive the identification from the alignment device.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the user interface is configured to visually indicate the next step.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and further wherein the similarity metric is computed by the alignment device.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, wherein the alignment device is configured to process the captured images.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and further wherein the alignment device is configured to integrate user experience data.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the document action extractor is configured to operate in conjunction with a processor.

(Currently Amended): An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the alignment device is configured to operate in conjunction with a processor.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, wherein the alignment device is configured to process the captured images.

(Currently Amended): The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and further wherein the alignment device is configured to integrate user experience data.

(Currently Amended): A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step is performed by a processor.

(Currently Amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and further wherein the identifying step is performed by a processor.

(Currently Amended): The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the user interface is configured to receive the identification.

(Currently Amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and further wherein the identifying step is performed by a processor.

(Currently Amended): The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the user interface is configured to receive the identification.

(Currently Amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and further wherein the similarity metric is computed by the alignment device.

(Currently Amended): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, and further wherein the computing step is performed by a processor.

(Currently Amended): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and further wherein the computing step is performed by a processor.

(Currently Amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, wherein the extracting step is performed by a processor.

(Currently Amended): A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, wherein the program of instructions is configured to operate in conjunction with a processor.

(Currently Amended): A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step is performed by a processor; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment.

(Currently Amended): The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, and further wherein the computing step is performed by a processor.

(Currently Amended): The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and further wherein the computing step is performed by a processor.

(Currently Amended): A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, wherein the program of instructions is configured to operate in conjunction with a processor.
